source.name: ACE3 Artillery Table (exported from the game)

ammunition.description: M269 launcher, name taken from the in-game HUD (ACE realistic names). Designation requires verification.

default.notes: dElevPer100m and dTofPer100m are the in-game 'D ELEV PER 100 M DR' and 'TIME OF FLIGHT PER 100 M DR' columns: change per 100 m of height difference. The remaining columns are the in-game weather corrections (ACE3 advanced corrections): azimuth correction in mil per 1 m/s of crosswind and range corrections in metres per 1 m/s of head/tail wind, per 1 °C of air temperature below/above 15 °C and per 1 % of air density below/above standard. Range corrections are added to the range used for the table lookup. A null value means the game table shows '-'. Exported from the game with web/tools/arma/export_tables.sqf (the same ACE extension computation as the in-game table), see web/data-sources. This profile is without air resistance; the advanced profile is with it. LOW mode: the D ELEV and TIME OF FLIGHT PER 100 M DR columns are negative (a higher target needs more elevation); some ranges are skipped by the game.
